title: Remove Invalid Parentheses
statement: Given a string containing parentheses and other characters, remove the fewest parentheses needed to make the string valid and return every distinct valid result.
explanation: Generate all one-parenthesis deletions at each BFS level. Stop after finding valid strings at the shallowest successful level.

title: Range Sum Query - Immutable
statement: Design a structure that returns the sum of nums from index left through right inclusive for repeated queries.
explanation: Precompute cumulative sums so each range query is one prefix subtraction.

title: Range Sum Query 2D - Immutable
statement: Preprocess a matrix so each query for the sum of an inclusive rectangular region can be answered efficiently.
explanation: Build a padded 2D prefix table and use inclusion-exclusion to get a rectangle sum.

title: Additive Number
statement: Return whether a digit string can be split into at least three numbers where every number after the first two equals the sum of the previous two.
explanation: Try legal first and second number lengths, then greedily match each subsequent decimal sum against the remaining string.

title: Range Sum Query - Mutable
statement: Support point updates to an integer array and inclusive range-sum queries.
explanation: A Fenwick tree updates one value in logarithmic time and obtains a prefix sum through logarithmic jumps.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
statement: Maximize stock trading profit when after selling, one day must pass before buying again.
explanation: Track the best profit while holding stock, just sold, or resting; transitions enforce the cooldown.

title: Minimum Height Trees
statement: Given an undirected tree, return all roots that produce a minimum-height tree.
explanation: Repeatedly remove all current leaves until one or two central vertices remain.

title: Burst Balloons
statement: Choose an order to burst balloons so the total coins, computed from each balloon's current neighbors, is maximized.
explanation: Add boundary ones and choose the last balloon burst in each interval, splitting the remaining problem into independent intervals.

title: Super Ugly Number
statement: Return the nth positive integer whose prime factors all belong to a supplied list of primes.
explanation: Maintain one pointer per prime and repeatedly append the smallest next product, advancing all pointers that produced it.

title: Count of Smaller Numbers After Self
statement: For every array element, count the elements to its right that are strictly smaller.
explanation: During merge sort, count how many right-half elements move before each left-half element and add that count to its original index.
